name: HZ_RELATIONSHIP_TYPES
description: The HZ_RELATIONSHIP_TYPES table defines the business rules that are associated with a relationship type. A non-directional relationship type consists of a single record with the same forward (FORWARD_REL_CODE) and backward (BACKWARD_REL_CODE) relationship codes. A directional relationship type consists of two records: one for the parent (DIRECTION_CODE is P) and the other for a child (DIRECTION_CODE is C) of that parent. Forward and backward relationship codes are validated against the PARTY_RELATIONS_TYPE lookup type.

columns.name: RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Relationship type identifier

columns.name: RELATIONSHIP_TYPE
columns.description: The relationship type name.  For example, CUSTOMER_SUPPLIER

columns.name: FORWARD_REL_CODE
columns.description: The forward relationship code used to describe relationships. For example, CUSTOMER_OF

columns.name: BACKWARD_REL_CODE
columns.description: The backward relationship code used to describe relationships. For example, SUPPLIER_OF

columns.name: DIRECTION_CODE
columns.description: Validated by DIRECTION_CODE lookup type. P for Parent, C for Child, and N for Not Directional

columns.name: HIERARCHICAL_FLAG
columns.description: No Longer used in Fusion V1.

columns.name: ALLOW_RELATE_TO_SELF_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if a party can be related to itself

columns.name: SUBJECT_TYPE
columns.description: Subject type of the relationship type

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE
columns.description: Object type of the relationship type

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Indicates if the relationship type is inactive or active. I for Inactive, A for Active

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ALLOW_CIRCULAR_RELATIONSHIPS
columns.description: Indicates if circular relationships are allowed using  this relationship type.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY_MODULE
columns.description: TCA Who column

columns.name: MULTIPLE_PARENT_ALLOWED
columns.description: No Longer used in Fusion V1.

columns.name: ROLE
columns.description: Unique relationship role lookup code based on relationship type and phrase. In the HZ_RELATIONSHIP_ROLE lookup type meaning is the plural role and description is the singular role.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
